brief:
Israeli forces detained a Palestinian groom during a wedding raid in the occupied West Bank on Friday, the Palestinian news agency Wafa reported. The detention occurred as Israeli forces and settlers carried out a series of attacks across the territory.

Settler violence has escalated across the West Bank, with attacks continuing despite international concern over the situation in the occupied Palestinian territories.
dek: Israeli forces detain Palestinian groom in wedding raid as settler attacks continue across West Bank Israeli forces and settlers carried out a series of attacks across the occupied West Bank on Friday, the Palestinian news agency Wafa reported.
title: Israeli forces detain Palestinian groom during West Bank wedding raid
